HudElement, Named
public final class ExampleDial extends AbstractHudElement
A circular element: a speedometer-style dial.

The reason Shape exists. Its layout box is square, but clicking the corner of that square should miss the dial, and the editor's selection outline should be a circle rather than a rectangle. Overriding getShape(float, float, float, float) gives both, because the editor asks the shape to stroke itself rather than assuming a rectangle.

  • Method Details

    • getPreferredSize

      public Size getPreferredSize()
      Description copied from interface: HudElement
      Current natural size.

      Expected to differ every frame. A clock is wider at 12:00 than 1:00, an ArrayList grows as modules are toggled. Nothing caches this, and the anchor formula makes a size change move the element in the right direction on its own.

    • render

      public void render(float x, float y, float w, float h)
      Description copied from interface: HudElement
      Draws the element with its top-left corner at (x, y).

      w and h are the natural size reported by HudElement.getPreferredSize() this frame, not the scaled size: any scale factor is already applied as a transform around this call.

    • getShape

      public Shape getShape(float x, float y, float w, float h)
      Description copied from interface: HudElement
      The clickable region, in natural coordinates within the given rectangle.

      Defaults to the whole rectangle, which is right for almost everything. Override it when the drawn shape is not a rectangle, so that clicking the corner of a circular element correctly misses it and the editor's selection outline traces the real shape.
